Game Overview

At its heart, Cave Jump is a jumping game about jump into "Cave Jump," a thrilling ascent through a perilous cavern. Dodge crafty robots and drones, outsmart shifting platforms, and collect life-saving power-ups. Precision taps and quick reflexes are your allies as you ascend higher in this exhilarating and ever-changing 2D platform adventure.

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Cave Jump is easy to pick up. Jump into "Cave Jump," a thrilling ascent through a perilous cavern. Dodge crafty robots and drones, outsmart shifting platforms, and collect life-saving power-ups. Precision taps and quick reflexes are your allies as you ascend higher in this exhilarating and ever-changing 2D platform adventure.
